purpose: Record source constraints that a modal-word-only extractor can miss. Entries are source-derived discovery items, not an assertion that the entire specification has been exhaustively reviewed.

examples: The character encoding of VCF files is UTF-8.
detection_classes.why_missed: No modal verb; the statement defines a normative format property.

examples: Zero length fields are not allowed.
Duplicate sample IDs are not allowed.
detection_classes.why_missed: The existing regular expression does not include 'not allowed' or 'disallowed'.
Declarative syntax/serialization constraint without a modal token.

examples: The last data line must end with a line separator.
detection_classes.why_missed: Although modal in this example, it is structurally scoped and needs separate discovery from generic line-ending support.

examples: Enumerated values, cardinality restrictions, grammar productions, reserved keys, and table-defined field domains.
detection_classes.why_missed: Requirements may be encoded in formal grammar, tables, enumerations, definitions, footnotes, and examples rather than prose modal sentences.

explicit_exclusions: Do not promote examples into requirements unless the example expresses a general constraint supported by normative context.
Do not infer VCFv4.0–4.2 applicability from later versions.
Do not treat BCF requirements as VCF requirements.
Do not treat producer-specific extensions as core VCF normative requirements without separate source classification.
remaining_work: Systematically inspect all 229 inventoried headings and 61 table captions in their pinned source contexts.
Extract and atomize every applicable table row, grammar production, enumerated value set, definition, footnote, and cross-reference.
Review all 510 modal-language candidates against preceding/following paragraphs and structural context.
Perform explicit per-version delta analysis, including requirements removed, introduced, modified, or unchanged.
Capture and hash the VCFv4.0 historical source bytes before promoting any VCFv4.0 requirement to source-pinned status.
Obtain independent second-person review; none is claimed in this register.
